app.source: GitHub release archive of SimpleMachines/SMF tag v2.1.7 (commit d49255b). The official download host (download.simplemachines.org) refuses this build venue (HTTP 403, Cloudflare), so the GitHub archive is vendored instead; its CONTENT was verified identical to a fresh second download of the same tag on 2026-10-13 (zip container bytes differ between GitHub generations; file contents do not). Substituting the official smf_2-1-7_install.zip once its checksum can be verified against simplemachines.org remains an open item (see ISO-BUILD-LOG, A23 RECIPE 1).

archive.refetch_note: KNOWN LIMITATION (Repo Review 2, B6; verified 2026-10-13 and again 2026-10-20): this URL is GitHub's auto-generated tag archive (the v2.1.7 release carries no uploaded assets). GitHub regenerates that zip's container bytes, so a fresh download's sha256 will NOT equal the pin (2026-10-20 generation: 733b9f16808b2097cebed4f0f6705887515c171ad4a3eb1f61ea675baed9d7fb) even though its extracted contents are byte-identical to the vendored archive (diff -r clean, 2026-10-20). The official host download.simplemachines.org returns HTTP 403 from every venue tried (sandbox, rig, 2026-10-20). The pin can therefore only be satisfied by the vendored archive, whose CONTENTS are the verified release contents; build/fetch-recipe-archives.sh verifies strictly and will refuse a fresh SMF download on hash mismatch - that refusal is this limitation surfacing, not a bug.
